name: forgetemple
description: A small software factory: spec, TDD build, code review, security review, approval, and a pull request.

spec_writer_model.title: Model for spec-writer
spec_writer_model.description: Model the spec-writer agent runs on. 'default' uses the runtime default (sonnet in Claude Code, neon in Antigravity, sol in Codex). A 'Factory models' section in the project CLAUDE.md (or AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md) overrides this.
